Here is the complete picture of everything related to the Jobs screen:

---

## Files Involved

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/pages/Jobs.tsx` | Jobs list screen (table, filters, approve/reject per row) |
| `src/pages/NewJob.tsx` | "New Job" form — selects type, fills fields, submits |
| `src/pages/JobDetail.tsx` | Individual job detail screen |
| `src/types/api.ts` | All type definitions for `JobType`, `JobStatus`, request shapes |
| `src/lib/api.ts` | Axios instance (`baseURL = VITE_API_URL`, Bearer token auth) |
| `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` | Exports `JobStatusBadge` used by the above pages |

---

## 1. Job Type Constants

Defined in two places that slightly differ:

**`src/types/api.ts` — the full canonical type union:**

```1:26:src/types/api.ts
export type JobType =
  | 'FIX'
  | 'REVIEW'
  | 'FIX_PR'
  | 'REPLY'
  | 'FIX_COMMENT'
  | 'HOOK'
  | 'GENERATE_TESTS'
  | 'GENERATE_DOCS'
  | 'SYNC_CONFLUENCE'
  | 'METRICS'
  | 'QUALITY_REPORT'
```

**`src/pages/Jobs.tsx` line 10 — filter list shown in the UI** (subset, excludes some system types):

```10:10:src/pages/Jobs.tsx
const JOB_TYPES: JobType[] = ['FIX', 'REVIEW', 'GENERATE_TESTS', 'GENERATE_DOCS', 'METRICS', 'QUALITY_REPORT']
```

---

## 2. Actions / Buttons

### Jobs list screen (`Jobs.tsx`)
- **Refresh** button — calls `refetch()` on the `/jobs` query
- **New Job** button — navigates to `/jobs/new`
- **Approve** (✓ icon) — per-row, only shown when `status === 'AWAITING_APPROVAL'`
- **Reject** (✗ icon) — per-row, same condition

### Job detail screen (`JobDetail.tsx`)
- **Approve & Merge** — shown in page header when `status === 'AWAITING_APPROVAL'`
- **Reject** — shown alongside Approve & Merge

### New Job screen (`NewJob.tsx`)
- **Submit Job** — submits the form

---

## 3. API Calls

### Fetching jobs
```typescript
// GET /jobs?status=<filter>
api.get('/jobs', { params: statusFilter !== 'ALL' ? { status: statusFilter } : {} })

// GET /status/:jobId  (auto-polls every 5s while RUNNING/PENDING/QUEUED)
api.get(`/status/${jobId}`)
```

### Approve / Reject
```typescript
api.post(`/jobs/${job.jobId}/approve`)
api.post(`/jobs/${job.jobId}/reject`, { reason: 'Rejected via UI' })
```

### Starting a new job — each job type calls its own endpoint:

```9:51:src/pages/NewJob.tsx
const JOB_TYPE_CONFIG: Record<
  string,
  { endpoint: string; fields: { name: string; label: string; required: boolean; type?: string }[] }
> = {
  FIX: {
    endpoint: '/run-fix',
    fields: [
      { name: 'repoUrl', label: 'Repository URL', required: true },
      { name: 'jiraKey', label: 'JIRA Key (optional)', required: false },
      { name: 'prompt', label: 'Prompt / description', required: false, type: 'textarea' },
      { name: 'branchName', label: 'Branch name (optional)', required: false },
      { name: 'targetBranch', label: 'Target branch (optional)', required: false },
    ],
  },
  REVIEW: {
    endpoint: '/review-pr',
    fields: [
      { name: 'repoUrl', label: 'Repository URL', required: true },
      { name: 'prId', label: 'PR ID', required: true },
    ],
  },
  GENERATE_TESTS: {
    endpoint: '/generate-tests',
    fields: [
      { name: 'repoUrl', label: 'Repository URL', required: true },
      { name: 'branchName', label: 'Branch name (optional)', required: false },
    ],
  },
  GENERATE_DOCS: {
    endpoint: '/generate-docs',
    fields: [
      { name: 'repoUrl', label: 'Repository URL', required: true },
      { name: 'branchName', label: 'Branch name (optional)', required: false },
    ],
  },
  METRICS: {
    endpoint: '/run-fix',   // <-- note: shares /run-fix endpoint
    fields: [
      { name: 'repoUrl', label: 'Repository URL', required: true },
      { name: 'branchName', label: 'Branch name (optional)', required: false },
    ],
  },
}
```

The submit handler posts `formData` to the selected endpoint:

```63:64:src/pages/NewJob.tsx
    mutationFn: () => api.post(config.endpoint, formData).then((r) => r.data),
```

### Notable gap
`QUALITY_REPORT` and `SYNC_CONFLUENCE` appear in `JobType` (and `QUALITY_REPORT` is listed in the `JOB_TYPES` filter array on the Jobs screen), but **neither has an entry in `JOB_TYPE_CONFIG`** in `NewJob.tsx`. This means they cannot currently be started from the UI — they are system-triggered or backend-only job types.

---

## 4. Job Status Values

```3:12:src/types/api.ts
export type JobStatus =
  | 'PENDING'
  | 'QUEUED'
  | 'RUNNING'
  | 'SUCCESS'
  | 'FAILED'
  | 'AWAITING_APPROVAL'
  | 'APPROVED'
  | 'REJECTED'
  | 'CANCELLED'
```

The status filter shown in the Jobs table UI uses a subset: `ALL | RUNNING | AWAITING_APPROVAL | SUCCESS | FAILED | PENDING`.
